selection_rule: Choose on validation before opening test: reduce false praise versus v1 while improving coverage macro F1; reject a separate off-topic head if its validation F1 is lower.
selection_reason: Ranking increased macro F1 slightly but caused twice as many false praises as the selected candidate on the validation set. The separate off-topic head performed worse than the cosine threshold.
limits: All training and synthetic test answers are developer-authored, and the private topic probe has only 24 developer-authored answers. v2 has lower off-topic F1 on synthetic test. Real user answers from multiple unseen presentations are required before claiming general reliability.
